name: VRM_MEA_DOC_CARVEOUT_LINES
description: This object stores the compliance carveouts for Multiple Element Arrangements.

columns.name: MEA_CARVEOUT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a carve-out adjustment line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: MEA adjustment status. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_ADJ_PROCESS_STATUS.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue line amount for a MEA line after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_UNIT_LIST_PRICE_DISC
columns.description: Unit list price discount percentage after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_BASE_PRICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Base price percentage after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON
columns.description: Carve out adjustment reason for a MEA. These values are from VRM_MEA_ADJ_REASON lookup.

columns.name: CARVEOUT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Carve out adjustment amount of a MEA line.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether carve out is reversed. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the latest activity. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date used for carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: PARENT_MEA_CARVEOUT_LINE_ID
columns.description: The information about the source carve-out line that has been reversed.

columns.name: ADJ_GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: The information about the gross margin percentage after a carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: The date the carve-out line was processed.

columns.name: CARVEOUT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: The difference between line amount and adjusted amount in percentage on carve out lines.

columns.name: MEA_CARVEOUT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Carve-out adjustment internal identifier.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID

columns.description: Total line amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.description: Total fair market value amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.description: FMV price representation type. Values are from the lookup VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS.
